messages:
sam: Heads-up — MerchantX POC kickoff. They want a 3-week eval (prod-like traffic replay), plus answers for DPA, SOC2, and an external pen-test ask. Can we confirm scope we can sign off on and a hit-by date?
anya: Got it. Quick summary of what they care about (from discovery): low-latency gen for chat (+context up to 4k), embeddings for rerank, and throughput ~150 rps during peak tests. Success criteria they'll accept:
- latency p95 < 250ms for single-turn gen (staging infra)
- accuracy: top-3 rerank MRR >= 0.62 on their eval set
- stable KV cache across context windows (no token duplication)
- no data exfil (all PII redacted in sandbox)
kevin: pricing questions they'll ask: do we offer a short Dedicated pool for POC (3-week reserved) or just hosted with surge? also need an estimate for expected token cost during the replay. i told them we'd give a ballpark.
olivia: @sam @anya security checklist we need to confirm for POC:
- DPA: we can provide our standard DPA draft; legal turnaround ~3 business days
- SOC2: share latest SOC2 Type II report (redacted) and an attestation letter
- Data handling: recommend synthetic or redacted real data in trial; if they insist on real PHI/PCI -> must be Private deployment (VPC) and explicit approvals
- KMS/HSM: we offer customer-managed keys for Private; hosted uses our KMS (encryption in transit+at-rest)
- Pen-test: we accept limited-scope external tests but require a pre-approved scope, testing window, and an NDA; no physical attacks, no social-engineering, and zero-day exploit disclosure path
sam: Nice. Can we put the pen-test pre-reqs into a short checklist to send MerchantX? keep it simple for procurement.
anya: I'll draft a 1-page preflight with acceptance criteria + test plan. Draft items:
- POC goals (latency, MRR, throughput)
- Evaluation prompts (we need MerchantX to provide ~200 labeled prompts for rerank + 50 generative prompts)
- Test harness commands to run on staging (they can run or we run and share logs)
Code snippet for eval we can hand off:
```
# run local eval against staging endpoint
python run_eval.py --endpoint https://staging-api.redwood.ai --prompts merchantx_prompts.json --out results.json --max-latency-ms 250
```
kevin: also need to confirm cost for a 3-week dedicated slice (N GPUs). if they commit, can we offer 20% off list for the POC? sales-ops please chime.
leo: security-bot: SOC2 report links uploaded to secure drive: https://internal.redwood/sec/SOC2-TypeII-2025.pdf (access request required). DPA template: https://internal.redwood/legal/dpa-template.docx
olivia: For the DPA: highlight liabilities and data deletion schedule (we default to 90 days log retention for hosted POC; can make configurable for Private). For HIPAA/GDPR: MerchantX is EU-based subset of customers -> need data residency in eu-west region; confirm if they need Business Associate Agreement -> escalate to legal if yes.
sam: Timeline proposal to share with MerchantX today:
- Day 0-2: sign SOW + DPA, grant staging creds (sandbox)
- Day 3-7: ingest prompts, run initial evals, tune prompts (SEs own)
- Day 8-14: throughput and latency soak tests using replay; if Dedicated requested, spin reserved nodes day 8
- Day 15-21: final acceptance, generate SOC2 summary + handoff docs
kevin: merchant contact asked about pen-test timing — they want to run external test week 3. acceptable?
olivia: Week 3 external blackbox test is OK if we get scope 5 days prior. We'll require a point of contact and a maintenance window (2h) for any noisy scans. Also require proof of insurance from their tester.
anya: I'll assemble the preflight PDF and include: prompts list template, eval command, keys/endpoint handling, and the pen-test short checklist. ETA: EOD today.
sam: Perfect. @kevin -- once you approve pricing language i'll attach to the preflight and send to merchantx.
kevin: Approved for sending with conditional 20% trial discount and note that Dedicated availability subject to infra capacity.
security-bot: Note: for any PII/PHI in prompts you MUST mark data as sensitive in the onboarding form (onboard.redwood.ai) — automated redaction only partial.
sam: Thanks all — i'll ping legal for the BAA conversation if merchant confirms PHI. sending to merchantx in the morning. :thumbsup:
